races.paceDynamic: Al Sayah will take them along at a comfortable gallop with no pressure, as he's the only confirmed front-runner in this field of 15. The real battle develops behind him where Matty's Getaway, La Pinsonniere, Serious Chat, Eagle Fang, Bold Endeavour, Sea The Clouds and Walking On Air all want prominent positions - creating a dangerous traffic jam approaching the business end. With 8 hold-up horses including Harbour Lake, Deep Cave and Lord Snootie needing room to make their move, the pace will quicken from 3 out as the prominent runners get squeezed and the hold-up brigade launches their challenge. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can avoid the prominent traffic and time their run from the back.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Heroes Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent congestion creates the expected traffic problems from 3 out
scenarios.body: The 8 hold-up horses get clear runs while the prominent pack gets shuffled back in the melee. Harbour Lake and Deep Cave, with their proven class and ability to find gaps, benefit most from the chaos ahead.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Survivor Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners can secure an ideal position and avoid the traffic
scenarios.body: The horse positioned perfectly just behind the pace avoids the worst of the congestion and has enough left to hold off the late challengers. La Pinsonniere or Serious Chat have the class to execute this.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Al Sayah Stays On
scenarios.trigger: If the lone leader maintains his advantage while the field battles behind
scenarios.body: With no early pressure, Al Sayah conserves energy and has enough in reserve when the closers come hunting. His good going record and front-running style could steal this if the pace collapses.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Al Sayah goes too slow and the prominent pack doesn't engage early enough
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from 2 out with no clear pace scenario, leading to an unpredictable finish where any runner can emerge. The form horses with tactical speed get first run.

watchPoints.text: The prominent congestion involving La Pinsonniere, Serious Chat, Eagle Fang, Bold Endeavour, Sea The Clouds and Walking On Air will create chaos from 3 out
Al Sayah's early pace setting - if he goes too fast early he'll stop, if too slow the field will swamp him turning in
Harbour Lake and Deep Cave getting clear runs from the rear - both need gaps to appear at the right time
Sea The Clouds returning after 166 days off with 10lb claiming jockey - fitness and jockey inexperience could combine badly
The 3 Henderson runners Harbour Lake, La Pinsonniere and Bold Endeavour represent 20% of the field from this powerful stable

races.paceDynamic: Bucephalus and Tellherthename will dispute the early lead, with both confirmed front-runners likely to set an honest gallop from the start. The prominent brigade of Helnwein, Indemnity, and Bubble Dubi will track close behind, keeping the pace solid through the middle sections. With 17 runners and multiple hold-up horses like Dance And Glance, Mr McLoughlan, and Laafi needing room to manoeuvre, the large field dynamics will create a searching test. This honest pace and competitive nature strongly favours prominent racers and those with tactical speed over pure hold-up horses who may struggle for clear runs.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Racers Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Helnwein or Indemnity track the leaders perfectly and avoid traffic problems in the straight.
scenarios.body: The moderate early pace allows prominent runners to stay close enough to strike, while hold-up horses get caught behind the wall of runners. Those positioned third or fourth turning for home have the perfect stalking position to win.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Holds On
scenarios.trigger: If Tellherthename or Bucephalus gets an easier lead than expected and kicks clear approaching the final flight.
scenarios.body: The leaders steal crucial lengths while the field scrambles behind, making their advantage insurmountable despite the challengers' late efforts. Early position proves decisive in this large field.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Success Story
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes genuinely strong and the field spreads out sufficiently to create clear passages.
scenarios.body: The strong gallop plays into the hands of the hold-up brigade who get the perfect setup to unleash their finishing kicks. Dance And Glance or Mr McLoughlan benefit from their patient tactics paying dividends.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Longshot Takes Advantage
scenarios.trigger: If the favourites get caught up in traffic problems or the pace collapses completely.
scenarios.body: Chaos in running allows an unconsidered runner like Made U Blush or Frontier Prince to steal through on the inside or benefit from a perfectly timed ride. The 4-year-old or light-weighted runner capitalizes on the mayhem.

races.paceDynamic: Double Combo will lead unchallenged from the gates with no other confirmed front runners in this field. The lone leader will dictate comfortable fractions through the early stages, with seven hold-up horses tracking behind in a bunched pack. This creates a tactical race where Double Combo can either sustain or collapse, while the large group of closers will need the pace to be strong enough to close into. The race shape strongly favours front runners and prominent racers, as Double Combo faces no early pressure and the hold-up brigade may struggle if the pace becomes too sedate.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Double Combo maintains a steady gallop without early pressure
scenarios.body: The lone leader controls the tempo perfectly and has enough left to repel late challenges. With no pace pressure early, Double Combo can time his effort optimally while the hold-up horses struggle to make ground.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Late
scenarios.trigger: If Double Combo goes too slow early and the field closes dramatically
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace allows the entire field to stay in contention turning for home, creating a cavalry charge finish. The strongest finishers with the best recent form will prevail in a blanket finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Leader Fades Dramatically
scenarios.trigger: If Double Combo's 112-day layoff tells in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The returning leader sets reasonable fractions but empties completely when challenged, allowing the best hold-up horses to sweep past. This becomes a contest between the strongest closers with Barbury Boy and Myrrh having the class edge.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Outsider
scenarios.trigger: If the weights tell and the lowest-rated horses outrun their marks
scenarios.body: Crown Inn To Win or Due To Shine benefit from their significant weight advantages and the race sets up perfectly for their hold-up styles. Their recent form suggests they're better than their ratings indicate.

watchPoints.text: Double Combo's fitness after 112 days off will determine if he can sustain his early advantage or collapse
The pace could become crawling with only one leader, making it tactical rather than a true test
Barbury Boy and Crown Inn To Win both prefer longer trips so watch for strong late surges
Keep It Classic has been fading in finishes recently despite being well-handicapped
Due To Shine carries bottom weight with apprentice claim but trainer Brian Ellison is winless in 19 runs

races.paceDynamic: Silver State, Applesandpears, Sea The Power, Jeddaal and Harlequin Breeze will ensure a furious gallop from the start, with Silver State's excellent recent form making him the likely pacesetter. This sustained pressure over a flat mile on good ground will create a strong end-to-end test that should catch out any horse needing time to get organized. The relentless tempo will set up a scenario where those able to track the pace prominently (Mohaaraj, Aerial Silk, Dodge City) or kick late from cover will have clear advantages. This race shape strongly favours prominent trackers and hold-up horses who can produce their best work when others are tiring.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If the multiple front-runners go too hard in the opening half-mile
scenarios.body: The early burn-out creates a stop-start tempo that allows patient hold-up horses to time their challenge perfectly. Blue To Blue and Delinquent can use their closing kicks to maximum effect when the pace setters fade.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Sustained Gallop Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Silver State and Applesandpears maintain honest fractions without going suicidal
scenarios.body: The even pressure tests stamina but rewards those tracking in the right position to strike. Mohaaraj and Dodge City can use their prominent styles to follow the pace and pounce when leaders weaken in final furlong.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If one of the leaders gets easy fractions by establishing early dominance
scenarios.body: Silver State or Applesandpears could steal a march by getting first run and maintaining their advantage to the line. The lack of early pressure allows them to save energy for a sustained finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Sprint Finish Develops
scenarios.trigger: If tactical riding creates a slowly-run race despite the number of front-runners
scenarios.body: The moderate gallop sets up a dash from the furlong pole where pure speed matters most. Horses with turn of foot from any position can win, but those already positioned will have the edge.

watchPoints.text: If Silver State breaks slowly, the entire pace dynamic shifts as he's the most reliable early leader in strong form.
Watch for Applesandpears and Sea The Power to need the run after their lengthy absences despite natural fitness.
Blue To Blue's hold-up style could be perfectly served if the multiple front-runners create genuine pace pressure.
Dodge City has been finishing strongly recently but needs to track closer than usual to capitalize on pace collapse.
Delinquent's quick return after winning suggests Burke has him spot-on for another bold showing from the rear.

races.paceDynamic: Balmacara and Release The Storm will set a legitimate pace from the start, with Release The Storm showing superior recent form (two wins from two) likely to dictate terms early. Poet Master and Myal should track the leaders closely in behind, while the large contingent of hold-up horses including Lake Forest, Holguin, Ten Bob Tony and Audience will settle towards the rear. The sustained gallop over 7f should create enough pace for the hold-up horses to finish strongly, but the modest early pace from just two confirmed front-runners may not be searching enough. This race shape moderately favours prominent runners who can track the pace and kick, rather than horses needing maximum gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Trackers Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If Poet Master or Myal can secure ideal positions tracking the leaders
scenarios.body: The moderate early pace allows these horses to stay close enough to strike decisively in the final furlong when the front-runners tire. Their tactical position proves superior to hold-up horses who find insufficient pace collapse to run at.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace proves more searching than expected between Balmacara and Release The Storm
scenarios.body: Lake Forest or Holguin benefit from the stronger gallop that opens up the race for their finishing kicks. Their class advantage tells when given proper pace to aim at in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Stays
scenarios.trigger: If Release The Storm's current form allows him to dominate from pillar to post
scenarios.body: His two recent wins show improving form and the modest opposition may not have enough tactical speed to reel him in. The lack of serious early pressure allows him to control the race throughout.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If both front-runners go too fast early and fade badly
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish between mid-division horses who avoided the early battle. Tactical positioning becomes crucial as the race turns into a messy scramble rather than a true test.

watchPoints.text: Release The Storm's early fractions are crucial - if he goes too fast trying to dominate, it opens up the race completely
Lake Forest needs to be prominent early in the betting despite his layoff, as his class could prove decisive if the pace unfolds correctly
Watch for Audience's response to the cheekpieces addition in the paddock and early stages
Poet Master's positioning behind the leaders will indicate whether connections believe the pace will be strong enough
Any market support for Holguin would be significant given the trainer's poor recent record and the horse's long absence

races.paceDynamic: Ata Rangi will dictate from the front as the only confirmed pace-setter, likely getting an uncontested lead in this 10-runner field. The prominent racers (Bravo Zulu, Son, Diamondonthehill, City Captain, Havana Blue) will settle just behind but won't apply early pressure, allowing Ata Rangi to control fractions. With multiple hold-up horses (Diligent Resdev, Warm Spell, Glenfinnan, One Night Thunder) needing to make late moves, the pace will be moderate early before quickening. This race shape strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can position close to the pace and kick from there.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Ata Rangi gets soft fractions and isn't pressured early by the prominent pack.
scenarios.body: The leader dictates comfortable splits and has enough left to repel late challengers over this seven-furlong trip. The hold-up horses find too much to do from their patient positions behind the solid pace.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Pounces
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent racers tracks Ata Rangi perfectly and times their move ideally.
scenarios.body: City Captain or Son sit in the box seat behind the leader and strike at the optimal moment when Ata Rangi begins to tire. Their tactical positioning proves superior to the deep closers who need more pace.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Surge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens enough mid-race to set up the hold-up horses for their customary finishing kicks.
scenarios.body: The prominent pack applies more pressure than expected, softening up Ata Rangi and creating the strong tempo that One Night Thunder or Warm Spell need. Their class tells in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Ata Rangi goes too slow early and multiple horses make simultaneous moves entering the straight.
scenarios.body: The tactical race becomes a sprint finish where any of the prominent or hold-up horses could prevail in a blanket finish. Form and class become secondary to who gets the clearest run.

watchPoints.text: Ata Rangi getting uncontested fractions - if no prominent horse applies early pressure, the leader will be very hard to peg back
The pace through the middle stages - if it stays too moderate, the hold-up horses will struggle to make their usual impact
City Captain's position turning in - the 4-year-old has tactical speed to be in the perfect stalking spot
How quickly One Night Thunder gets into his stride - the headgear suggests connections expect improvement but he needs help from pace
Son's finishing kick from his tracking position - David Allan knows how to place this horse perfectly for his run
